correctness.rationale: For a vacancy in the a-part, a mixed fully occupied b-part would force simultaneously (a-1)y <= (b-1)x <= (a-1)(y-1), impossible. Pure opposite part yields no strictly improving move, including same-part moves. Enumerating the mutually exclusive all-red or all-blue opposite-side cases gives E=a[C(a-1,r-b)+C(a-1,r)]+b[C(b-1,r-a)+C(b-1,r)]. Balanced K_m,m gives 2m colored equilibria and 2/binom(2m,m) probability. On K_{a,2}, the red and blue pair orientations give welfare a+1 and 2+4/(a-1), hence exact PoA (a-1)/2. Independent literal-payoff enumeration checked 2<=a,b<=4 and welfare a=3..7; these finite checks do not establish the all-parameter theorem.
